input_statements.text: We operate as one reporting segment, with subscription solutions and merchant solutions as revenue components.
Merchants use our commerce platform to sell to their buyers across online storefronts and physical retail locations.
Our subscription plans serve businesses from entry level through enterprise, with additional functionality and support for larger merchants.
Subscription solutions include platform subscriptions, a premium point-of-sale subscription, apps, themes and domain registration.
Merchant solutions earn payment-processing and currency-conversion fees through our integrated merchant payment service.
Other merchant solutions include lending services, shipping-label sales, point-of-sale hardware sales and advertising offerings.
An integrated back end supports inventory, transactions and buyer relationships across the merchant's sales channels.
App developers, theme designers and service partners extend the platform for merchants; these partners are distinct from merchants and buyers.
Our offline revenue includes payment services for physical commerce, point-of-sale subscriptions and hardware, spanning multiple offerings.
Gross Merchandise Volume measures orders facilitated through the platform, net of refunds and including shipping, handling, duty and value-added taxes.
Gross Merchandise Volume describes merchant sales activity, whereas subscription and merchant-solution fees are revenue earned by our company.
The reported business-to-business selling feature is available to merchants on our higher-tier plan, connecting a specific offering to that subscription tier.
